verdict.rationale: Notion's docs describe creating pages and databases and working with users through the API and MCP. Community users report using it to track tasks and projects and as a project and issue tracker, so task creation in databases is supported. However, nothing in the pack explicitly documents assigning a task to a teammate or setting a due date, and one user says notifications are hit or miss. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of assignee (person) and due-date properties on tasks, a first-party task-management or assignment workflow, and hands-on corroboration of assign-and-due-date use.
